name: Microgrid site-controller watchdog interface
aliases: microgrids Microgrid supervisory and communication interfaces
summary: Transfers the controller's declared self-health output to independent supervision.
description: Transfers the controller's declared self-health output to independent supervision. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Controller watchdog output” at the input and “Site-controller fault indication” at the output. Watchdog coverage has defined limits.
